remarks: This beautifully updated condo offers the perfect blend of modern amenities and convenient one-level living, making it an ideal choice for both homeowners and investors.  Step inside to discover an updated kitchen boasting granite countertops, a breakfast bar, and sleek stainless steel appliances. The open layout flows seamlessly into the living and dining areas, creating a spacious and inviting environment.  Enjoy the convenience of a washer/dryer in-unit and an updated bathroom, both designed for your comfort. The outdoor deck space is perfect for relaxing and enjoying the fresh air.  This condo includes a one-car garage and additional storage area, providing ample space for your belongings. Its location is unbeatable, especially for Norwalk Hospital employees - you can walk to work!  Investors will also appreciate the potential for rental income from hospital staff seeking nearby accommodations.  Don't miss out on this fantastic opportunity to own a stunning condo in a prime location. Schedule a viewing today!
